title: Puthoff later briefs Grusch's group

tellings.quote: somewhere in that period they finally got to be meet with Hal put off and and he briefed them with his set of information

plain: A team working with a former intelligence officer turned whistleblower named David Grusch is said to have finally got a meeting with a physicist named Hal Puthoff. Puthoff then briefed them on what he knew. A physicist and longtime Puthoff colleague named Eric W. Davis tells this as something he heard about. If true, Puthoff's knowledge fed into Grusch's claims.
